title: Congress leaders protest at Jaipur Police Commissionerate over alleged assault
seoTitle: Jaipur Congress protest over worker assault

tea.why: Protesting the alleged assault on NSUI National Secretary Ritu Barala by female police personnel during a demonstration in Delhi.
tea.want: Demanding the registration of a Zero FIR regarding the alleged assault.
tea.changed: Oct 20: Rajasthan Congress leaders continued their overnight protest at the Jaipur Police Commissionerate.

summary: Rajasthan Congress leaders and workers staged an overnight sit-in protest at the Jaipur Police Commissionerate, demanding the registration of a Zero FIR over the alleged assault of NSUI National Secretary Ritu Barala by female police personnel during a demonstration in Delhi. The demonstration saw participation from senior political figures, including the Rajasthan Congress president, the Leader of Opposition in the Rajasthan Assembly, and several women MLAs, alongside various party workers who spent the night sleeping in the commissionerate's corridor. Protesters criticized senior officials for being unavailable and accused authorities of refusing to file the case under political pressure. In response, police kept the main gate closed, deployed additional personnel, and erected barricades to prevent party workers from entering the premises.
demands: Register a Zero FIR immediately over the alleged assault
Proceed with an investigation into the matter
response: According to the sources, police kept the main gate closed, erected barricades to prevent party workers from entering the premises, and deployed additional personnel while refusing to register the requested FIR.

updates.text: Congress leaders and workers began an overnight dharna at the Jaipur Police Commissionerate.
The protest continued into Tuesday with more party leaders and workers joining the site.
